column1: # Conformance vectors of the COR ingress rule of github.com/fiberfx/mx-echo/v6, package reqid: ReadCorrelation, and
# CorrelationOf, which returns its COR. This file is canonical in that module at reqid/testdata/correlation/; a copy
# elsewhere is byte-identical to the one of the mx-echo version it pins.
# The rule: the first Baggage member whose key is bcs.correlation.id gives the COR when its value, without properties,
# trimmed of spaces and tabs and percent-decoded, is a valid COR; else the X-Correlation-ID header gives it when it is
# one; else the request has none. An invalid value counts as absent, with its reason; it is never truncated or repaired.
# Every implementation of the rule passes every row.
# Columns are separated by one tab. No field is empty; "-" stands for an absent value.
#   baggage         the Baggage header values in order, separated by "|"; "-" when the request has none
#   header          the X-Correlation-ID header value; "-" when absent
#   want            the COR the rule returns; "-" for none
#   member          the value of the first bcs.correlation.id member as the rule reads it (without properties, trimmed,
#                   percent-decoded); "-" when no member has the key, its value is empty or an escape is malformed
#   baggage_reason  the member: ok, absent, escape (a malformed percent escape) or a refusal
#   header_reason   the header: ok, absent or a refusal
# In baggage, header and member "\t" is a tab and "\\" a backslash; in baggage "\|" is a literal "|".
# Refusals: the strict parse of the Ecd ID (ecd-id spec/id.md): length, separator, alphabet, pad, reserved,
# system-reserved, kind; cor-kind for a valid eid of another kind; cor-system for a valid eid of kind cor from a system
# that may not issue one (a registered system that is retired or has no live cor row in the ecd-id registry at
# go/v0.6.1, which leaves mxe alone; a detached-class system always may). want follows from the reasons: the member
# when baggage_reason is ok, else the header when header_reason is ok, else "-".
